presentation.guidance: Prose is the natural carrier for causal narrative; concrete anchors are optional and must not dominate.

allowed.carrier: Causal narrative prose (trigger → current state → cost)

forbidden: Before/after comparison tables (belongs in GO)
Scope or exclusion tables (belongs in SC/NG)
Structure or flow diagrams

required: Opens with problem-domain narrative before path or code inventories
States user-perceived or system-behavior consequence, not code structure alone
forbidden: Opening paragraphs that lead with file:line or DOM id chains
Checkbox steps, Run commands, or phase markers

presentation.guidance: Comparative semantics fit contrast carriers; structural outcomes must cover engineering-visible dimensions, not only user-visible behavior.

allowed.carrier: Before → after comparison table (one row per dimension)

forbidden: Narrative prose goal statements without before/after contrast
Checkable invariants list (belongs in I)
Scope tables or architecture diagrams

required: Goal statements must be observable: pass/fail judgeable, not only directional
Cover both behavior-visible and structure-visible dimensions in the contrast view
forbidden: Background narrative duplicating CTX

presentation.guidance: Scope content is a mapping relation (surface → change nature); mapping structure is the natural carrier when implementation locations are identifiable.
forbidden: Checkable invariants list (belongs in I)
Rejected-direction comparison (belongs in KD)
Exclusion list (belongs in NG)

required: Surfaces covered by this design in structured form when more than two items

presentation.guidance: Each exclusion must bind to the design boundary or invariant it protects; listing 'what we won't do' alone does not carry boundary semantics. Rationale belongs in KD.
forbidden: Comparison table with rationale column (belongs in KD)
Trade-off reasoning prose (belongs in KD)
Interface contract tables (belongs in IF)

required: Each exclusion identifies what design boundary or invariant it protects
forbidden: Repeating the in-scope list from SC

presentation.guidance: Invariants are a set of independent propositions; each self-contained — covering one item alone still allows a true/false judgment. Nested dependencies or pure reference chains break this independence.
forbidden: Full API response field tables (belongs in IF)
Phase tables or checkbox steps

required: Each invariant is semantically self-contained when present
forbidden: Items that only say 'see IF'/'see GO' without invariant content

presentation.guidance: Select carrier by whether a reviewer can read relationship semantics directly without inference; carrier is determined by the relationship type in the content. When content contains dependency relations, a directed form (A → B) carries directional semantics — a responsibility assignment table does not carry direction and does not satisfy this criterion. When content contains state transitions, a state/trigger/terminal-state structured view carries state-machine semantics — narrative sentences do not satisfy this criterion.

allowed.carrier: State machine view (state | trigger | terminal state)
Cross-boundary data flow table (source → boundary → target)

forbidden: Responsibility assignment table (pure responsibility column, no direction)
Narrative sentences describing state transitions
Field-level API or schema tables (belongs in IF)

required: When design introduces new modules, components, or services: annotate name and responsibility boundary
All names must be identifiable system artifacts — existing ones or explicitly marked as new
forbidden: Opening with architectural positioning or design rationale (belongs in KD)
Rejected-option comparison and rationale (belongs in KD)
Task steps, file edit lists, or Run commands (belongs in lulu-plan)
Decorative diagrams that carry no structural semantics
Placeholder names like 'some module' or 'related service'

presentation.guidance: When multiple paths were genuinely considered, a comparison structure is the natural carrier for reasoning semantics; row count is determined by paths actually considered. When only a single direction was considered, do not force a comparison table.

allowed.carrier: Direction comparison table (direction | conclusion | design rationale | reopen condition)
Narrative reasoning (single decision, no genuine alternatives)

forbidden: Module relationship view duplicating ST
Interface field tables (belongs in IF)
Phase tags, Owner, or Timing tables (belongs in lulu-plan)

required: Design reasoning for the selected direction beyond stakeholder authorization
Comparable contrast view when multiple paths were genuinely considered
forbidden: Selected direction rationale consisting solely of stakeholder authorization references

presentation.guidance: Contract content type determines carrier: input/output paths map to result → terminal-state structure; field/type definitions map to field-constraint tables; naming conventions/flag semantics map to the corresponding structured form.

allowed.carrier: Contract behavior table (input | success terminal | warning/empty | failure terminal)
Field constraint table (field name | type | semantics | constraint)

forbidden: Module responsibility prose duplicating ST
Implementation steps or file patches

required: Cross-boundary semantics in structured form when more than one field or endpoint
Success, warning, and failure terminal-state semantics when interaction or visible result changes
Data schema, naming convention, feature flag, or compatibility contract in appropriate structured form when more than one element
Contract entry must include function name, command name, typed field definition, or schema name — behavioral description alone does not satisfy this requirement
forbidden: Standalone path-specific prose duplicating table row content

presentation.guidance: Tracking semantics (question × blocking status × closure path) is the natural carrier; each entry must have a closure path.

allowed.carrier: Question tracking table (item | status | related design gap | closure condition)

forbidden: Run commands, test file paths, or checkbox steps
Phase or task breakdown tables (belongs in lulu-plan)

required: blocks-plan or non-blocking label on each item
forbidden: Items that only repeat IF/VD content without unresolved assumptions

presentation.guidance: Acceptance intent, verification method, and pass signal together form a complete evidence chain; items without a pass signal cannot be used for acceptance.

allowed.carrier: Acceptance matrix (acceptance intent | verification method | pass signal | design error signal)

forbidden: Standalone test strategy tables that largely duplicate acceptance matrix rows
Run commands or test file paths

required: Each acceptance intent paired with verification method and a judgeable pass signal
At least one falsifiable condition (explicit failure state)
Cross-reference applicable OQ assumptions when closing verification gaps
forbidden: Repeating NG exclusion list as regression test prose

presentation.guidance: Content is risk narrative; prose is the natural carrier for reasoning continuity; structured view is clearer when multiple independent risk dimensions are listed in parallel.

allowed.carrier: Risk dimension table (when multiple independent dimensions)

forbidden: Five-heading chain (observability/release/degradation/rollback/risk each one sentence, no reasoning continuity)
Runbooks, metric threshold tables, or repair scripts
Verbatim copy of SC surface change table

required: Explicit rollback scope and data consistency stance
forbidden: Run commands, test file paths, or checkbox steps
